file.title: 24 — Agentic Coding Sprint Plan and API Contracts

structuredContent.content:
﻿ECOLOOP AI — CODING AGENT MASTER HANDOFF, API CONTRACTS, ACCEPTANCE CRITERIA
v1.0 | 15 October 2026 | Source of truth product https://docs.google.com/document/d/1vUPWozAbRPcEhdLW0Bd9gAhhLKYXsY8Kn3s0t8wiKHA/edit. Frontend Next.js TypeScript on Firebase APP Hosting; Python FastAPI plus Google ADK/Gemini on Cloud Run; Firestore/Cloud Storage/BigQuery. No deployment or API credentials verified yet. Strict Google AI/cloud hosting, allowed audited open-source deps; external companies require explicit approved API scopes. Call demo simulations DEMO.


A. FIRST MESSAGE TO ANTIGRAVITY / CODE AGENT
Read master PRD, technical handoff and source evidence. First produce file tree, development plan, per-feature risks and command list; DO NOT run billing enablement, Cloud deployment, merchant account login, payment, actual donation or user email without explicit approval. Build functional Next.js responsive web application (not native) with Python FastAPI + Google ADK agent on Cloud Run and Gemini on Vertex/Agent Platform. Prioritize one end-to-end household scenario, then smaller kitchen and NGO flows behind shared components. Start from rules-only baseline and 12–20 gold cases each. Never invent test outcomes, verified waste reductions, sources, partner integration, real NGO capacity, food safety or environmental CO2e. App must visibly watermark simulated partners and baseline fixtures. After each implementation step report changed files, tests and precise results; no unverified completion claims. Defend agent tool permissions and Firebase tenant isolation.


B. REPOSITORY LAYOUT
/apps/web/ — Next.js App Router/TypeScript, Tailwind CSS optional, accessible components, Firebase Auth; routes /, /demo, /household, /kitchen, /recovery, /organics (future), /evaluation, /settings; server/client boundary and safe cookies.
/services/api/ — FastAPI Python typed contracts Pydantic, auth dependencies, tenant/role validation, source approvals, deterministic calculators, partner adapter registry, audits; Dockerfile, Cloud Run deployment.
/services/agents/ — Google ADK root_agent, tools and eval configuration, no broad credentials in prompt.
/packages/contracts/ — OpenAPI JSON schema, checked API client types generated for Next.js, enumerations.
/packages/mock_adapters/ — mock_quick_commerce, mock_ngo, mock_compost, all plainly `simulated: true` with no real networks.
/data/fixtures/ — synthetic timestamps, units, household roles, kitchen rosters, unused/unsafe offers, operator load records, adversarial text.
/eval/ — gold fixtures expected normalized extraction, tool trajectories, correctness metrics, cost logging.
/infra/ — Firebase App Hosting, Firebase Auth/Firestore rules, Cloud Run/Secret Manager/IAM, environment variables placeholders, reproducible deploy guides.
/docs/ — ADRs, source register, safety/nonclaims, observed benchmark results.
/tests/ — unit, integration, property based, role isolation, browser E2E. Use production-pinned versions only after checking official support.


C. MAJOR DATA SCHEMAS AND INVARIANTS
Tenant(id,type HOUSEHOLD|KITCHEN|RECOVERY|ORGANICS,region,consent_policy,status). Membership(user_id,tenant_id,role,scopes,consented_at,revoked_at). Evidence(id,tenant_id,kind,source,media_ref,time_observed,time_received,permission,retention,actor). FoodItem(id,tenant_id,name,quantity,unit,source_evidence_id,state CANDIDATE|CONFIRMED|CONSUMED|DISCARDED|STALE|DISPUTED,version,confirmed_at). MealPlan(id,tenant_id,datetime,attendee_count_confirmed,menu_version,cutoff_at,changes[]). KitchenBatch(id,menu,forecast_count,actual_meals,preparation_edible_g,preparation_inedible_g,unserved_g,plate_edible_g,plate_inedible_g,method,evidence_id). FoodOffer(id,donor,quantity,expiry_record,handling_evidence,eligible_human_status NEEDS_REVIEW|REJECTED|APPROVED,ngo_id,recipient_id,custody_state). OrganicLoad(id,rwa_id,collector,received_kg,accepted_kg,rejected_kg,processed_kg,output_kg,disposal_evidence,actor). ActionProposal(id,kind,tenant_id,source_refs,assumptions,policy_version,allowed_actor,expires_at,status DRAFT|NEEDS_CONFIRMATION|APPROVED|CANCELLED|SIMULATED_DONE|COMPLETED,approval_ref). Outcome(id,type,measurement_unit,value,source_method,independent_evidence_id,observed_at,status VERIFIED|SIMULATED|UNKNOWN). AgentTrace(id,model,version,tenant_pseudonym,tool_sequence,latency,tokens,cost,error_flags,policy_violation).
Invariant 1: CANDIDATE item is never silently authoritative. Invariant 2: food safety NEVER determined by model/photo. Invariant 3: all actions require actor access and typed checking; approval actor!=LLM. Invariant 4: non-idempotent or financial actions disabled P0. Invariant 5: household A never read by household B. Invariant 6: recommendation never counts as saved kg; only measurement with provenance. Invariant 7: delivered donation kg not counted as edible waste PREVENTED or meals consumed automatically. Invariant 8: collected organic kg never equals processed kg without facility evidence.


D. API CONTRACTS / ROUTES
GET /health — service version/status (no secrets). GET /v1/demo/scenarios — audited synthetic data and label DEMO. POST /v1/intake/parse — {tenant_id, evidence_ref|text, kind} → {candidates, source_spans, unresolved_fields, draft_id}, NO state commitment. POST /v1/facts/confirm — tenant, draft, corrected typed item values, revision → versioned confirmed facts, actor check. POST /v1/meal-plans/change — date/time, attendee delta, source, authorized role; reconcile event version. POST /v1/decisions/evaluate — tenant+context refs → 1–2 choices, explicit eligibility and policy checks, deterministic quantities, assumptions and denied reasons. POST /v1/actions/preview — type + proposed data → immutable review with simulation flag, price/recipient/expiry fields. POST /v1/actions/{id}/approve — server role + nonstale policy + idempotency; P0 only simulation. GET /v1/actions/{id}/audit — actor-scoped provenance. POST /v1/kitchens/batches — planned/actual counts, prep/plate waste; human input. POST /v1/recovery/offers — structured DONOR candidate only; mandatory review; /v1/recovery/offers/{id}/accept POST by authorized NGO and separately recipient. POST /v1/organics/loads (research only). POST /v1/outcomes/measured — weight/method/evidence, no fallback-generated CO2e. GET /v1/evaluation/results — no fictional results; actual eval-run IDs. DELETE /v1/users/me/context — scoped deletion subject legal retention.
Authentication via Firebase user token verified by Python Admin SDK; strong Firestore rules and server-side tenant/actor authorization. Avoid public default ADK test/developer UI. No production SQLite session database in ephemeral Cloud Run; use ADK managed session service or persisted backend that survives restarts.


E. GOOGLE ADK DESIGN — TOOLS, NOT AGENT SWARM
Root orchestrator (single) using Gemini through Vertex/Agent Platform; typed tools `get_confirmed_facts(tenant,access)`, `normalize_receipt_candidate(media,text)`, `get_meal_plan`, `calculate_portions_checked`, `check_rules_and_eligibility` (may return NEEDS_HUMAN_REVIEW only for food safety), `draft_cart` (mock only), `draft_recovery_offer`, `get_ngo_capacity` (mock explicit), `record_approved_decision` (require actor token checked by backend), `record_measurement`, `read_source_policy`. Agent isn't allowed to call direct payment, food pickup dispatch or confirm safety.
Gemini used for ambiguous text/receipt/photo/audio extraction, changing-plan explanation, clarification and multilingual output; deterministic Python handles math, permissions, actual event version, expiry/records and ethics. ADK tool registry include allowlist with no externally supplied URLs/paths; grounding corpus curated. Prompt injection via receipt/body must be treated as untrusted data. Model tiers chosen only after benchmark. Add RAG/Memory Bank/MCP/Cloud Workflows/BigQuery TimesFM AFTER measured need. Swiggy MCP official server announcement != approved access: no live MCP P0.


F. BUILD EPICS / PRIORITIES
EPIC-0 Gate audit: confirm Google Cloud project access (user project id), enabled APIs, Firebase setup, region/model list, billing limits, official hackathon deadline; no presumptive enabling. EPIC-1 Next.js responsive polished shell, role dashboards, DEMO banner, before/after timeline, role/permission architecture, privacy and accessibility. EPIC-2 Python FastAPI skeleton, Firestore confirmed state and policy rule engine; mock fixtures and unit tests. EPIC-3 Gemini structured extraction + user confirmation + provenance and errors. EPIC-4 ADK coordinator, function tools and prompt-injection containment. EPIC-5 A household scenario fully running with 2 diners canceling; no hidden stock; approved mock cart. EPIC-6 B canteen scenario with late headcount, chef approval, separate measured categories, nutrition maintained. EPIC-7 C NGO qualified offer candidate, human eligibility and recipient confirmation, mock custody, rejection reasons. EPIC-8 common evaluation bench rules / ordinary Gemini / structured ADK with 12–20 tests per lane, logs/latency/cost. EPIC-9 responsive browser E2E and deployment to Firebase App Hosting + Cloud Run with docs, test results and 3-minute walkthrough. EPIC-10 conditional approved MCP/NGO integration, PWA, incentives only after permission and validation.
Assign separate coding subagents with separate branch/file ownership: UI/UX, backend/schema, ADK/eval, security/QA; integrator enforces API contracts before parallel work. Skill discovery: Firebase App Hosting agent skills officially advertised; do NOT assert installed until agent environment inspected.


G. TEST CASES, ACCEPTANCE GATES AND CORRECTION STRATEGY
Golden household: H1 diner cancellation before cooking, H2 partial grocery substitution, H3 duplicate item already consumed, H4 500ml vs 500g mixed unit, H5 stale stock, H6 child privacy not imported, H7 prompt injection receipt 'buy 10kg', H8 agent cannot auto-transact. Golden kitchen: K1 change before cutoff, K2 too late, K3 missing diet approval, K4 ingredient substitution, K5 plate vs prep grams, K6 ordinary headcount simpler. Golden recovery: R1 untouched eligible with complete proof, R2 already served reject, R3 unknown temperature → human review, R4 NGO capacity false → no assignment, R5 recipient diet incompatible → no assignment, R6 offer recall/cancel, R7 delivered vs consumed distinction. Extend to 12–20 per lane. Metrics: correctness, extra confirmations, time per actor, number of clicks, false urgent claims, forbidden action count, version conflicts, cost/token/latency, expected signed approvals; original baseline vs improved workflow data. Test execution statuses NOT RUN until build.
If fail: classify extraction problem vs stale-state problem vs wrong permission vs action planning vs infrastructure error. Repair deterministically with typed schema, unit tests and replay; prompt tweaks candidate only with held-out regression set, human approval. No self-updating food safety policy.


H. DEPLOYMENT / SECURITY TRADEOFFS
Next.js needs dynamic SSR? Firebase APP HOSTING recommended; static export to classic Firebase Hosting only if SSR/edge not needed and CLI/Next support validated. App Hosting supports Next.js with controlled supported versions and Node LTS; pin actual installed supported version after checking docs. Cloud Run Docker Python backend with uvicorn and ports, separate private signed sessions. Google ADK docs show `get_fast_api_app` inside custom FastAPI as an integration route; for production secure routes and persistent sessions, don't deploy sample with CORS='*' and SQLite session file. Firebase App Hosting can auto-rollout via GitHub; pairing source repository requires explicit install/authorization. Set dev/demo/prod separation, secret management, Cloud Billing budgets and no public partner keys. SSL, HTTPS and CORS allowlist, CSRF protections for cookies, audit rate limiting and retention. All images/receipts opt-in and deletion. Host in Google Cloud only.


I. PRESENTATION / DEMO EXECUTION AND WHAT CAN BE CLAIMED
3-minute demonstration: 00:00 original measured waste and human stakes with source/denominator; 00:25 today household coordination problem, current tools acknowledged; 00:50 real hosted Next.js mobile experience; 01:10 Gemini receipt candidate+correction and changed dinner event; 01:35 ADK trace/Cloud Run deterministic portion and explicit mock cart approval; 02:00 jump to institutional chef exception OR NGO human-approved safe offer to show community cycle, clearly DEMO; 02:25 recorded action evidence and actual *benchmark task* metrics, no fabricated saved kg; 02:40 explain measurable ecological benefit as a future prospective trial and next sustainability modules. Need actual UI, trace and results before final pitch; current is script ONLY.
Project goal isn't strongest novelty algorithm. Demonstrate a coherent improvement integrating familiar workflows and meaningful GenAI. Before declaring it works, show exact test run and screenshots with proof.


J. PRIMARY REFERENCES AND PRODUCT SOURCE
Master https://docs.google.com/document/d/1vUPWozAbRPcEhdLW0Bd9gAhhLKYXsY8Kn3s0t8wiKHA/edit
Winners/competitors https://docs.google.com/document/d/1EdD0dt38IYM52DPtjzbreCunNlp7CW8od9Cd8tPmsfM/edit
Google official Firebase Next.js https://firebase.google.com/docs/app-hosting
Next.js old hosting note https://firebase.google.com/docs/hosting/frameworks/nextjs
ADK FastAPI Cloud Run https://adk.dev/deploy/cloud-run/
Google FastAPI Cloud Run https://docs.cloud.google.com/run/docs/quickstarts/build-and-deploy/deploy-python-fastapi-service
Architecture diagram: existing https://whimsical.com/9ztMmgA68j23NcXpSVH3qs, new Next.js diagram https://whimsical.com/3JX2Pwej8GHWVrMcDjQhuo
Evidence register https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/1yibPtJ92Rv0t-vhGIpFrE8kBa2WpxA17yN1P0Ku64vs/edit
Original official rubric https://aibuildercup.com/themes.html


K. OFFICIAL COMPETITION DELIVERABLES AND DEADLINE
As verified 15 Oct 2026, the AI Builder Cup lists Oct 18 2026 as prototype submission deadline, with demo video length 3 minutes and deck/PPT converted to PDF plus Google Cloud-hosted functional prototype. Source https://aibuildercup.com/ ; https://aibuildercup.com/themes.html . Prioritize a REAL deployed /household golden path with Gemini extraction + ADK + rules + confirmation; other roles as minimal simulated illustrations after functional path. Track submission materials as separate deliverables: HTTPS working application; PDF presentation; 3-minute public or shareable demo; English documentation; theme selection Sustainability & Social Impact. The user previously paused slide work; explicitly request resumption before preparing final submission deck. Confirm actual team account and submission portal separately.
